description: Crypto market brief: One parameter-free call: BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP spot price, 24h change, market cap and 24h volume, with a one-word 24h tone; pass ids to brief up to 12 CoinGecko ids instead. Source: CoinGecko. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: tone_24h, assets[]{id, price_usd, change_24h_pct, market_cap_usd, volume_24h_usd}.
